summary: Propagates a mass-related double across a collision-tree chain. For each node, blends the stored double at this+0x10 halfway toward the value at this+0x4 using the 0.5 constant (dbl_59E880), then iterates four consecutive child-pointer slots starting at this+0x4C recursing into every non-null child, and finally follows the sibling link at this+0x5C until it is null. Called by CollisionContactResponse (00449700).

local_names.this: current tree node; advanced via the sibling link at this+0x5C
local_names.v2: cursor over the four child-pointer slots beginning at this+0x4C
local_names.v3: loop counter for the four child slots
local_names.result: return value of the last child recursion

operations.description: Blend toward the target: *(this+0x10) = (*(this+0x4) + *(this+0x10)) * 0.5, where 0.5 is the read-only double constant at dbl_59E880
Inner loop: walk the four consecutive child-pointer slots beginning at this+0x4C (cursor v2, count v3=4)
For each non-null child slot, recursively call PhysicsTreeMassPropagation on that child
Outer loop: advance this to the sibling node at this+0x5C and repeat while the sibling link is non-null
Return the result of the last child recursion once the sibling chain terminates
Invoked by CollisionContactResponse (00449700) during collision handling
